status_carried_from_7HD1.contact_current_float64_cause: HYPOTHESIS_SUPPORTED_BY_ULP_CORRELATION (not yet confirmed by controlled intervention)

physics: identical to 7H-D1 (J1 junction, NA=ND=1e17 cm^-3, T=300 K, taun=taup=1e-8 s, domain x in [-0.5,0.5] um, 2D height 0.1 um = 1e-5 cm, ohmic contacts, production setup functions unmodified)

solver.acceptance: info=True converged AND final device relative update < 1e-10 (identical in every precision variant)

precision_variants.scope: global set_parameter (manual 9.3.2); set explicitly (False too) at process start and read back; a run whose readback differs aborts

fixtures.R1: 1D J1, h = 0.02, 0.01, 0.005, 0.0025, 0.00125, 0.000625, 0.0003125 um (finer levels only as precision reference), all P0-P4
fixtures.R2: M2 D0 (structured right triangles), h = 0.02, 0.005, 0.00125 um, all P0-P4
fixtures.R3: M1 D0 (irregular non-obtuse), h = 0.02, 0.005, 0.00125 um, all P0-P4
fixtures.R4: M3 D1 (Delaunay-obtuse, signed override), h = 0.02, 0.005, 0.00125 um, all P0-P4; plus h = 0.0025 um P0 and P4 for the -0.10 V sign-crossing analysis
fixtures.mirror: 1D h = 0.005 and M1 D0 h = 0.005 with x -> -x (mesh and doping), bias on the p contact (right), P0 and P4
fixtures.sources: h 0.02/0.005/0.0025 from 7H-D1 fixtures_d1.json (read-only); h 0.00125 from data/fixtures_d2.json (7H-D1 builder)

bias: p contact: +0.025..+0.10 V (record +0.05, +0.10) from the 0 V DD state; rebuilt device -0.025..-0.10 V (record -0.10); 0 V recorded
stop_condition: per run 3600 s wall time or crash -> NOT_COMPLETED, no retry

observables.C1: sum over edges with exactly one contact node of (Jn+Jp)*couple_used, +1 if the contact node is n0
observables.C2: cuts x_c = -0.25, -0.10, 0, +0.10, +0.25 um; L = {x < x_c}, R = {x >= x_c} (node on the cut -> R); each L-R edge once; +1 if n0 in L; couple_used = OvEdgeCouple (D1) else EdgeCouple; 1D couple 1
observables.C3: between consecutive cuts: dI_n vs +q sum(USRH*V), dI_p vs -q sum(USRH*V), dI_total vs 0; V = node volume used by the equations

tolerances.derivation: a conserved-current observable used to certify a reference whose 7H-D1 uncertainty was 7.4e-5 must agree to at least 10x better: 1e-5 relative
tolerances.zero_bias: |I| <= 1e-6 * |I(-0.10 V)| of the same run and observable

reproduction_P0: P0 reproduces the 7H-D1 defect iff 1D h = 0.00125 um at +-0.10 V has |C0_left + C0_right| / |C0_left| > 1e-5

restoration.per_flag: variant Pk restores iff on every completed run of Pk at +0.05/+0.10/-0.10 V: (a) |C0_left + C0_right|/|C0_left| <= 1e-5; (b) 5-cut spread max|I_cut - median|/|median| <= 1e-5; (c) |C0_left - I_cut(0)|/|I_cut(0)| <= 1e-5; and (d) the 1D C0_left sequence over h 0.0025, 0.00125, 0.000625, 0.0003125 has strictly decreasing successive changes and finest change <= 1e-3 relative, at every bias
restoration.verdicts: P1 restores -> FLOAT64_MODEL_CANCELLATION_CONFIRMED; P2 -> FLOAT64_EQUATION_ASSEMBLY_CONFIRMED; P3 -> FLOAT64_SOLVER_PRECISION_CONFIRMED (several allowed). P4 restores but no single flag -> float64 causal, attribution INCONCLUSIVE. P4 does not restore and its (a) mismatch is within a factor 2 of P0 everywhere -> PRECISION_NOT_CAUSAL; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

cut_certification.mode: the restoring single-flag variant(s), else P4
cut_certification.INTERIOR_CUT_CURRENT_CERTIFIED iff: in that mode: 5-cut spread <= 1e-5 (all runs, biased points); |C0_left - I_cut(0)| and |C0_right + I_cut(0)| <= 1e-5 relative; M2(h) cut currents vs 1D(h) <= 1e-8 relative; mirror: |I_m(-x_c) + I(x_c)| <= 1e-5 |I(x_c)| at all 5 cuts; C3 |dI_n - q int U| and |dI_p + q int U| <= 1e-5 |I_cut(0)|; C1 vs C0 couple identity; zero-bias rule
cut_certification.INTERIOR_CUT_CURRENT_NOT_CONSERVATIVE if: C3 total (dI_total) exceeds 1e-5 |I_cut(0)| in that mode
cut_certification.INTERIOR_CUT_CURRENT_POSITION_DEPENDENT: C3 holds but the 5-cut spread exceeds 1e-5

A_reevaluation.mode: certifying precision mode (P4 unless a single flag certifies)
A_reevaluation.reference: 1D cut current I_cut(0) at h = 0.0003125 um; U_ref = |I(0.0003125) - I(0.000625)| / |I(0.0003125)|; converged iff U_ref <= 0.01 and the successive changes over the finest 3 changes strictly decrease
A_reevaluation.potential_reference: 1D P4 h = 0.0003125 um psi (per-side 4-point Lagrange, 7H-D1 interp); U_psi = finest-pair change
A_reevaluation.M2: same-h vs 1D: cut currents <= 1e-8 rel, psi <= 1e-9 V
A_reevaluation.M1_and_M2: e_psi, e_logc (0 V), and every-cut current error strictly decrease over h 0.02 > 0.005 > 0.00125; finest e_psi <= max(5 U_psi, 1e-6 V); finest current error (every cut, every bias) <= max(5 U_ref, 0.02); cut spread <= 1e-5; positivity; qf <= 1e-6 V; mass action <= 1e-6; zero-bias rule; every solve accepted
A_reevaluation.verdict: NONOBTUSE_DEFAULT_SG_DD_CONVERGENCE_VALIDATED iff all of the above for M1 D0 and M2 D0; scope = this symmetric 1e17 abrupt junction, one region, 300 K, DEVSIM 2.11.0

M3_D1.verdict: SIGNED_OVERRIDE_CONVERGENCE_VALIDATED_FOR_NONNEGATIVE_TRANSMISSIBILITY iff the A conditions hold for M3 D1 plus 0 negative signed couples and node volumes (fixtures) and C1 vs C0 couple identity; also E_peak and y-variation errors strictly decrease over the 3 levels
M3_D1.sign_crossing_classification_at_-0.10V: noise iff |e_P0 - e_P4| > 0.5 |e_P4| at the same h; spatial discretization iff not noise and |e(0.00125)| < |e(0.0025)| < ... measured in the certifying mode; override problem suspected iff not noise and |e(0.00125)| >= |e(0.0025)|

terminal_current: TERMINAL_CURRENT_REMAINS_NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED iff no precision variant restores C0 per restoration (a)-(d)
